verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit runs as an unattended bot that reviews every pull request automatically, and its request-changes review can block merges as a CI-style gate. It also reads CI/CD pipeline failures and posts fixes. An official CLI exists that coding agents such as Claude Code can trigger without manual intervention, and an OpenAPI spec suggests a programmatic API. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a non-interactive/headless CLI mode for CI pipelines (flags, exit codes, machine-readable output), documented API usage for automation, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
